Is This New CowanSim H125 Sound Pack Worth It in MSFS?

The Marketplace Ban List Grows: CowanSim H125/AS350 Sound Review

📝 Description
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the empty shelves on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive shift in recent Marketplace changes that represent a major cleanup of third-party vendors and leave us with a highly anticipated helicopter audio overhaul.

We dive deep into a premium value upgrade for the CowanSim Airbus H125 / AS350 B3e created by DHM Studio to see if it delivers a truly immersive rotorcraft experience. Packing multi-level recorded engine RPMs, a complete tactile audio overhaul for every single cockpit switch, realistic ambient temperature acoustics, and those distinctive blade-slapping rotor sounds recorded with professional microphones and vetted by real-world pilots, it brings a massive realism boost to the helicopter fleet. Because we can't test audio before buying in MSFS 2020, we discuss how this specific package would massively benefit from the upcoming MSFS 2024 marketplace trial features.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know your thoughts on the marketplace cleanup or the new H125 audio pack!
